About the brand

PodiaFarm was created by a Russian manufacturer with more than 25 years of experience in professional cosmetics. The products are designed for foot and nail care, and some are suitable for people with diabetes.

These products are cosmetic care products, not medicines. If you have symptoms of a condition, book an appointment with a specialist first.

Podolog Podiatry and Orthopedics Center. Head: Zhanna Kim.
